tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: The point of intersection and sudden increase in the slope, in the diagram given below, respectively, indicates:

options.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>ΔG</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and melting or boiling point of the metal oxide

solution.text: At intersection point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>ΔG</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and sudden increase in slope is due to melting or boiling point of the metal.
